entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: A plane whose present belongs to the dragons, ruled by five legendary dragonlords after Sarkhan Vol changed history.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who travelled back in time and saved Ugin, ensuring dragons' continued existence on Tarkir.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A planeswalker spirit dragon saved from death by Sarkhan; the dragon tempests feed on his magic.

entities.name: The Dragon Tempests
entities.description: Storms that feed on Ugin's magic and birth dragons.

entities.name: The Khans
entities.description: The five powerful clan leaders who would have ruled Tarkir in a different present; the dragons hunted them down and destroyed them.

entities.name: The Dragonlords
entities.description: Five legendary dragons who now rule the defeated clans.

events.summary: Sarkhan travels back in time more than a thousand years and saves Ugin from death, ensuring the dragon tempests and thus dragons continue.
events.quote: he travelled back in time more than a thousand years to a crucial turning point, and there he saved Planeswalker Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, from death.

events.summary: With dragons secured, their numbers grow and the tide of the war turns.
events.quote: With the dragons' presence secured, draconic numbers grew and soon, the tide of the war turned.

events.summary: The dragons hunt down and destroy the khans and claim the vacant thrones.
events.quote: Ultimately, the dragons were able to hunt down the khans and destroy them.

events.summary: The defeated clans come to be ruled by five legendary dragonlords and battle for control of Tarkir on their behalf.
events.quote: In this present, the defeated clans are ruled by five legendary dragonlords.

relations.quote: he saved Planeswalker Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, from death.
